gpu_accounting: ExecutionPlan requires a positive ceiling; the backend is CPU-only and actual ASR GPU usage must be zero. This ceiling does not authorize GPU ASR.
purpose: At most one cold CPU Whisper full-utterance decode per four-row source, only after the main model selects its native speech tool. Warm requests remain real internal tool invocations with zero ASR forward. No transcript is prepared before selection.
retry_policy: No automatic ASR retry or fallback. Preserve any failed selected contact and stop for root diagnosis.
